items.title: Bernard Purdie interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: And then you pick out one that wasn’t necessarily a big hit for her but yet yeah, it was me also.

ctx.x: So it’s funny with you, it’s not just that you played on that one, you played on all four versions of it. That’s terrific.

Yeah. But see that’s what happens. Now I can’t tell you why all the other things just came up. And I can just say it because it happened. That’s what I mean by what’s in the memory bank. When you hear something. Something strikes up and then all of a sudden you go back to what you did originally. And I find that yeah, there are four different versions that I did that were all hits by the different people. And then you pick out one that wasn’t necessarily a big hit for her but yet yeah, it was me also. And that’s…
